title: From Amazon to Zara, Here Are All the Best Black Friday Deals, Promo Codes & Coupons
summary: Black Friday is here! Shop Billboard put together a list of deals on audio essentials, fashion, tech and other product categories from retailers across the web.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With all of the excitement and fun surrounding Thanksgiving over and done with, it’s time to think about the holiday shopping season with massive Black Friday sales across the internet.

For shoppers, Black Friday weekend offers up a chance to save money online, with Hanukkah and Christmas down the line. With economic worries continuing, retail analysts say shoppers are searching for marked down prices and deals with inflation looming and budgets shrinking.

However, retailers across the web — such as Amazon, Best Buy, Coach Outlet, Dick’s Sporting Goods and others — are boasting deep discounts during Black Friday weekend on all sorts of items, including the latest fashions, footwear, tech, kitchenware, home and bedroom essentials and more. In fact, Shop Billboard found the best deals online from top retailers — from Abercrombie & Fitch to Zara.

BEST CASUAL FASHION DEALS

Abercrombie & Fitch

Shop Deals Here

For Black Friday weekend, Abercrombie & Fitch is offering up to 50% off apparel for men and women, while the retailer is offering an additional 25% off list prices on all clearance items. And, orders over $99 can get for free shipping.

BEST OUTLET DEALS

Amazon

Although Amazon just had Prime Big Deal Days back in October, the retail giant is having another big sale event with up to 60% off list prices for Black Friday . We found Beats by Dre headphones are 53% off retail. Plus, select mattresses are marked down by up to 30% off list price. All Thanksgiving and Black Friday weekend long, you’ll find deals on fall essentials, holiday wears, tech and much more.

BEST APPLE & IOS DEALS

Apple

From Apple AirPods Pro to Apple MacBook Neo, just about everything from Apple on Amazon is on sale for Black Friday with savings up to 40% off list prices.

BEST TECH DEALS

Best Buy

Although Best Buy has great deals on tech and gaming for Black Friday with savings up to 50% off, the retailer has massive discounts on home appliances from brands such as Samsung, LG, Frigidaire, Bosch and others.

BEST HANDBAG DEALS

Coach Outlet

Shoppers can save up to 70% off select styles for Black Friday while Coach Outlet is offering an extra 20% off in savings.

BEST SPORTS DEALS

Dick’s Sporting Goods

For Black Friday, Dick’s Sporting Goods has up to 70% off sitewide on top brands including Adidas, Nike, On Running, Under Armour and others.

BEST VACUUM DEALS

Dyson

For Black Friday at Dyson, you can save up to $400 across product categories such as floor care, air purifiers, headphones, haircare and more, sitewide.

BEST CRAFTS DEALS

Everlane

Throughout Thanksgiving and Black Friday weekend, Everlane is offering up to 50% select holiday and winter styles for men and women , while shoppers can get an additional 40% off styles too.

BEST MERCH & APPAREL DEALS

Fanatics

With the 2026-27 NFL season in full swing, fans can get up to 50% off NFL jerseys and gear for Black Friday weekend on Fanatics with promo code WRAP at checkout. Gear starts as low as just $1.99 for car decals.

BEST MUSIC TEES DEALS

Gap

BEST RUGGED MENSWEAR DEALS

Huckberry

BEST FURNITURE DEALS

IKEA

It might be time to upgrade your home decor. IKEA has a few key deals sitewide during Black Friday . Throughout the holiday weekend, shoppers can save up to 30% off select sofas and sectionals, as well as up to 20% off select dining rooms and dinnerware.

BEST SHOE DEALS

Journeys

BEST HOUSEHOLD GOODS DEALS

Kohl's

At Kohl’s, shoppers get up to 85% off all clearance items , including men’s and women’s clothing, home essentials, small appliances, beauty, toys and others, throughout Thanksgiving and Black Friday weekend. Plus, shoppers can get up to an extra 50% off select items with promo code LOVE2SAVE.

BEST JEANS DEALS

Lee

BEST ATHLEISURE DEALS

Lululemon

BEST BEDDINGS DEALS

Macy's

Shoppers can get up to 70% off sitewide at Macy’s for Black Friday . This includes new arrivals and fall/winter fashion essentials, as well as clothing, shoes, handbags, jewelry, home goods, furniture and other categories.

BEST SNEAKERS DEALS

Nike

For Black Friday at Nike, you can save up to 50% on select styles sitewide . In fact, you can save an extra 25% with promo code BFRIDAY at checkout.

BEST UPMARKET DEALS

Nordstrom

From Adidas, Madewell, Petal & Pup, Vince, Free People, UGG and other brands, you can save up to 60% list prices sitewide from Nordstrom . This includes up to 30% off beauty and skincare, as well as 40% off clearance items.

BEST CLEARANCE DEALS

Nordstrom Rack

With up to 75% off sitewide, Nordstrom Rack has thousands upon thousands of styles on sale right now, including new markdowns on designer brands such as Good American, ASTR the Label, Tommy Hilfiger, Adidas, Cole Haan, Longchamp, Coach and others. There’s discounts on jewelry, too.

BEST CLOTHING ESSENTIALS DEALS

Old Navy

Old Navy’s Black Friday sale offers up to a whopping 90% off most items sitewide, including up to 50% off new arrivals for fall. It’s a good time to stock up on basics, while shoppers can get an extra 10% off purchases when signing up for text alerts.

BEST LIFESTYLE APPAREL DEALS

PacSun

Over at PacSun, shoppers can get up to 70% off select items in all categories. Plus, the retailer is offering free shipping on most orders. Meanwhile, shoppers can get up to 70% off all clearance items.

BEST RETAIL BUNDLE DEALS

QVC

QVC’s Black Friday sale is going on now with discounts on select items for up to 50% list and bundle prices. The sale event even includes an additional marked down of up to 50% off clearances items. At QVC, you can save big on fashion, tech, home essentials, patio items and more.

BEST MUSIC STREAMING DEALS

Qobuz

For music streaming in various genres, Qobuz has up to 62% in savings across the service’s offerings, including subscriptions, student discounts, downloads and even gift cards.

BEST OUTDOOR GEAR DEALS

REI

At REI, it’s time for the retailer’s Black Friday sale on men’s and women’s wear, camping essentials, recreation equipment and more with savings up to 50% off list prices. And, if you’re a member of the retailer’s reward program, you can get an additional 20% off one REI Outlet item.

BEST TICKET DEALS

SeatGeek

You can use SeatGeek for cheap tickets online. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

BEST FRAGRANCE DEALS

Sephora

Save up to 30% on fragrances, perfumes, colognes, body mists, gift sets and more , as well as get 4x rewards when you use the promo code CYBERSCENT at checkout at Sephora. And, save up to 50% off sitewide.

BEST COMFY DEALS

Skechers

Shop these awesome Black Friday deals with Skechers . Through the holiday weekend, shoppers can save up to 60% on select styles sitewide. And, Skechers Plus members can take an extra 15% off with promo code BF2026 at checkout.

BEST SHAPEWEAR DEALS

Skims

At Skims, save up to 30% off list prices in every categories sitewide. You can get free shipping on orders over $75 at checkout.

BEST HOME ESSENTIALS DEALS

Target

Target has deals on all sorts of items and categories for Black Friday , with up to 50% off kitchen items, up to 40% off sports apparel and up to 50% off toys and floor clear items. Order online and pick it up for free at your nearest Target store location.

BEST TICKETING DEALS

TicketNetwork
